verdict.rationale: Polar documents webhooks (event notifications) and automated dunning retries, but these are fixed system behaviors, not a user-configurable rules engine where an AI-native user defines custom event→action triggers. The MCP server lets agents query/act on data but is agent-driven, not rule-based automation configured to fire automatically. Missing for 10: any documented rules/automation builder, conditional triggers, or workflow-action mapping UI/API.
